candidate.name: LiteParse
candidate.authoring_model_provenance: GPT-6 Sol, medium reasoning, selected source-bound fixtures before parser outcomes; Codex root visually checked three PDF pages using model-assisted inspection; neither is independent human review

source_authority: Frozen GOV.UK PDF bytes and their existing unreviewed machine-extracted page JSON. Page JSON anchors are test references; PDF layout review is needed before claiming the structure is correct.

comparison.baseline: fresh pdftotext -layout -enc UTF-8 extraction over the identical contiguous PDF-page windows
comparison.unit: one selected source PDF window, with original one-based PDF page numbers retained
comparison.normalisation: For ordinary anchor checks only, collapse runs of Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space. The declared case-014 exception removes all Unicode whitespace to compare the PDF-verified clean phrase with Poppler's spaced-letter extraction. Preserve letters, digits, punctuation and order; do not accept semantic paraphrases or infer spelling accuracy from this exception.
comparison.cross_page_limit: Contiguous PDF pages establish source order, not a logical-unit join. Record joins and body/navigation classification as unassessed unless a tested assembly adapter implements them.

advance_if: All bound source paths, PDF and page hashes, page indices and required text are verified.
All candidate outputs are readable and within configured resource bounds.
Every declared critical anchor is retained in its source window after whitespace normalisation, with declared order preserved where applicable.
No regression in the two declared cross-page source controls; do not infer a logical-unit join from page order alone.
At least one declared typed table has fully correct row and column association under PDF layout review, with no table degradation elsewhere.
stages.on_fail: Record the failed gate and stop; make no stage 2 parser calls.

advance_if: All stage 1 gates continue to hold on the full 36-case set.
No critical-anchor loss. Record body/navigation confusion and semantic joins as unassessed unless a separately tested unit-assembly adapter evaluates them against the source.
At least one reproducible structural improvement remains after checking the frozen PDF layout.
stages.on_fail: Record the failed gate and stop; make no conditional 40-case replay.

conditional_replay.additional_prerequisites: Use a separately tested unit-assembly adapter and frozen variant inputs; raw PDF blocks alone cannot establish body/navigation roles or semantic cross-page joins.
conditional_replay.interpretation: Known outliers and previously reviewed controls are regression cases. Fresh source-selected windows are new to this parser, not independently human-reviewed and not a blinded prevalence estimate.

prohibitions: No LLM answer or defect-detector calls
No source mutations or dependency resolution during validation or execution; separate pinned setup was authorised
No legal applicability, answer-quality or specialist-acceptance claims
